text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the Kikuka Sho, Agnes Tachyon confesses to me that her legs might one day prevent her from being able to run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she can't reach the limits of Umamusume potential with her own legs, she would have no choice but to entrust said pursuit to another Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, my own determination bolsters her resolve, motivating her to fulfill her dream with her own two legs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After realizing she's been fighting a battle alone this whole time, I promise to do everything in my power to help her. Thus…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our days in pursuit of Umamusume potential begin once again. First up is a G1 race—the Osaka Hai.
